Controls & Game Info

Current mode: Destroy Base
Input Action
Left Click / Drag Select units and buildings / box select
Shift + Left Click Add/remove clicked unit or building from current selection
Ctrl / Cmd + Left Click Toggle selection for all visible units/buildings of the clicked type (select all of type)
Right Click Move / attack / assign workers / set rally (resets selected groups to this single point)
Shift or Ctrl + Right Click Add a point and split selected spawners/units across all set points
Z Attack-move mode for selected units
X Stop selected units
C Hold position for selected units
F Cycle level visibility (Everything -> Buildings -> Off)
Mouse Wheel Zoom camera in/out around cursor position
Minimap Left Click Center camera on clicked minimap location
Minimap Right Click Issue move/rally/attack-move commands from minimap (supports multi-point with Shift/Ctrl)
* / / / E / Q Apply subgroup unit x2 / /2 to each active selected unit subgroup (E=x2, Q=/2)
1..9 Select control group
Shift + 1..9 Assign selected units to control group
Esc Close this help popup (if open), otherwise clear selection/build mode
R/T/Y/U/I/O/P Open popup control group (if assigned)
Shift + R/T/Y/U/I/O/P Assign current selected subgroups to popup control group
Long Press (touch) Simulate right-click for rally/commands when enabled
Gameplay and rendering options
Leveling & stacks
  • Most buildings/items scale with stacks. Displayed level is based on stacks (roughly $L=\lfloor\log_2(\text{stacks})\rfloor+1$).
  • New manual stack adds are now queued: menu/info stack text is shown as stacked/manual (for example 8/12).
  • Queued stacks use the Stacking state and are built by builders; each completed stack costs base energy (level-1 energy) of that thing.
  • A secondary stacking progress bar is shown directly above the energy bar while queued stacks remain.
  • When both are possible, buildings prioritize level-up/upgrading before stacking.
  • You may see base vs effective values in the right panel; effective values include adjacency/group/area bonuses.
  • Units also show their own level (for example `L1`, `L2`) and subgroup toggles are level-aware.
Areas & adjacency
  • Connected structures/items form groups; bigger connected groups can increase effective power.
  • Each tile belongs to an area. Area-level multipliers (M0..M5) increase output for objects inside that area.
  • Area Up upgrades are available when an area is fully filled and can be leveled up step by step.
Economy basics
  • Collectors gather energy from mines and farms; farms multiply collector gather speed.
  • Barracks/spawners queue units at purchase-time costs and use their current rally target on spawn.
Core status effects
  • Fire: burst damage + burn over time.
  • Poison: poison damage over time.
  • Ice: slow/freeze pressure.
  • Water: wet/soak state, often enabling stronger ice follow-up.
  • Sand: movement slow/control.
  • Watch: marks targets for vision sharing (revealed while watched).
Combinations & counters
  • Water + Ice is a key combo path (wet targets are easier to lock down).
  • Layering DoTs (Fire/Poison) with control (Ice/Sand) is effective against groups.
  • Some unit lines are resistant/immune to specific elements or tower damage types.
  • Some tower families resist their own effect type; mix damage types to break through.
Win conditions
  • Destroy Base: eliminate enemy core/base structures.
  • Kill King: defeat the enemy king unit to win.
Useful strategic notes
  • Use rally splitting to spread reinforcements or stage flanks.
  • Use minimap right-click to set distant rallies/commands instantly.
  • Auto-upgrade + salvage controls in the right panel help macro-management.
